simbad_service.query: SELECT main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, otype FROM basic WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 269.4463, 4.7667, 0.1))=1

limitations: Refused because every epoch is saturated or flagged at the star in detector 6; this is a property of the data, not of our settings.
Barnard's Star moves 10″ per year (1.7 px), so the preset position is propagated; the catalogue match puts it 0.88 px from SIMBAD.
